questions.q: What two qualities does radical candor combine?
a: Direct honesty with genuine care for the person
Public praise with private criticism
Clear targets with generous bonuses
Frequent meetings with detailed reports
questions.why: Lesson 1 defines it as being thoroughly open while caring about the people you challenge.

questions.q: How did Scott's boss deliver criticism after her presentation?
a: She wrapped the feedback inside a compliment
She sent a written note the next day
She raised it in front of the whole team
She assigned her extra training sessions
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes the boss telling her to say um less, then adding that she was too smart for it.

questions.q: What does the summary say Steve Jobs did as a collaborative leader?
a: He asked employees to speak up when they disagreed
He made every decision without consultation
He avoided giving feedback to his team
He rotated staff between departments
questions.why: Lesson 2 says Jobs wanted people to challenge him so he would not make mistakes.

questions.q: What did Russ Laraway learn about his employee Sarah?
a: She dreamed of owning a farm
She planned to leave the company
She wanted a bigger sales budget
She hoped to relocate abroad
questions.why: Lesson 3 says Sarah eventually revealed her wish to own a farm, which changed how he supported her.

questions.q: Which conversations does the summary recommend for learning motivations?
a: The life story, the dream job and the 18-month plan
The annual review, the salary talk and the exit interview
The team survey, the peer review and the weekly standup
The performance warning, the bonus talk and the promotion plan
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists those three talks as ways to uncover what really drives your employees.
